title: fix(cli): support --bare in pnpm init (pnpm/pnpm#15538)
body: ## Summary Closes pnpm/pnpm#15538 Adds the `--bare` CLI flag to `pnpm init` in pacquet, scaffolding a minimal `package.json` with only the required fields (`devEngines`, `packageManager`, and `type: "module"`) rather than the full scaffold. ## Squash Commit Body Add the `--bare` CLI flag to `pnpm init` in pacquet, scaffolding a minimal `package.json` with only the required fields (`devEngines`, `packageManager`, and `type: "module"`). Closes pnpm/pnpm#15538 ## Checklist - [x] I checked the referenced issue and verified that none of the PRs already linked to it solves it. - [x] New features are implemented only in the Rust pnpm v12 CLI. Bug fixes are implemented in every affected version. - [x] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if this PR changes any published package. Keep it short and written for pnpm users — it becomes a release note. - [x] Added or updated tests. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. Autofix is disabled. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added the `pnpm init --bare` option to create a minimal `package.json` instead of the standard scaffold. * The option respects applicable initialization settings, including the requested license and version, and can be combined with options to omit the package manager entry or select CommonJS. * Added `--bare` to the `pnpm init` help output.
